name: Ogichin ~Daiikkai Ogiue ga Futanari Dattara Dou Suru ka Kaigi~
original_name: おぎちん ～第一回荻上がふたなりだったらどうするか会議～
source:
Ogiue is an otaku girl who frequents club's sessions and likes to draw manga. But she has a secret - she is actually a hermaphrodite...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
荻上是一名沉迷社團活動、喜歡畫漫畫的御宅女孩。然而她有一個秘密：其實她是雙性人……
